injuries.provider: NFLMeta per-club verified reports plus ESPN dated player reports
injuries.timestamp_basis: Latest dated club or player report; each player expires independently; request time ignored

nflmeta.provider: NFLMeta weekly club game-status reports (per-club verification)

injuries.note: Only players of clubs with a complete verified NFLMeta report, or with an exact dated ESPN report, are cleared.

weekly_rosters.timestamp_basis: HTTP Last-Modified for the exact downloaded parquet bytes

snap_roles.provider: GOING football_context from nflverse snap counts/PBP

method.injury_effect: Median injured-week outcome divided by the same player's prior four healthy active weeks; minimum three baselines; ratios winsorized 0.25-1.15 and shrunk toward position/status priors with strength 25; positive injury boosts prohibited.
method.playing_through: At least 10% offensive snaps; Out and Doubtful excluded.
method.replacement_role: Current observed snap, target and rush shares plus timestamped depth evidence. The browser applies market-specific bounded transfer caps.
method.scheme_limit: Current blitz splits require 50 charted dropbacks. Current-season man/zone participation is unavailable in-season and is not inferred.
method.causality: Observed association only; not medical advice and not proof that injury caused the change.
